title: Quest-hint directions (e.g. 'ask in Reedholm, then out onto the fen: two stands west, then in') didn't match the actual room-exit labels needed to reach the location; the real path required going east from Fenmarch Causeway through several unlabeled rooms, not 'west' as the hint implied.
